source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    top = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row))
    bottom = max(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v != 0 for v in row))
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
    cols = [c for c, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(grid[top], grid[bottom])) if a != 0 and a == b]
